notes.title: Playtest Patch Notes 2024-11-24
notes.content:
New Playtest Build Available 🎮

Change Log 🔧:

🐢 Reduced memory overhead of textures.

🐞 Fixed a bug where Max HP from Fusion Core Exosuit upgrade did not persist with death.
🐞 Fixed a bug where you get stuck on a blank Augmentation selection screen if you only had Overclock and opened an Augmentation Upgrade crate.
🐞 Corrected controller control scheme to display the right buttons.
🐞 Fixed a bug where more enemies would spawn after already having received the room's reward.
🐞 Fixed a bug where you couldn't dodge through enemies.
🐞 Fixed a bug where the Augmentation Upgrade selection screen would show duplicate Augmentations.

👍 Player currencies get saved upon exiting from a run instead of only when dying.
👍 Added support to hit B / ESC to back out of menus.
👍 Animated the ellipsis on the Loading Screen.
👍 Moved the dash cooldown indicator to the centre of the screen.

🚀 You no longer stop dead when dashing into walls and obstacles at an angle. Instead you slide along them.
🚀 Increased the speed of the Pistol's Alt Fire (slow moving orb).
🚀 Pistol's Alt now grows over time and passes through enemies.
🚀 You can target explosive barrels now.
🚀 Unlocked the Shop room by default and removed it as an unlockable room from Elpis Access menu.
🚀 Reduced base speed of Explosive Spider Bombers.
🚀 You can now hold down RT / LMB for Pistol's Primary Fire instead of having to spam it. Shoots every 0.5s.

❓ Added tooltips to Exosuit Upgrades and improved the look of the UI.
❓ Added info notifications describing the next room's reward when moving into range of a room's exit.

⚖️ Made the first few rooms only have initial wave of enemies, 2 waves for later rooms and 3 for the last few.

✨ NEW Suit Upgrade: Liquid Cooling - makes healing effects more potent.
